<!--
  The main column of AppShell: the heading, the metric tiles, and the chart panel (beside the activity panel
  when `activity` is given).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Metric } from "../blocks/metric-row.types";
import type { Point } from "../blocks/chart-panel.types";
import type { Event } from "../blocks/activity-feed.types";
import type { OverviewChart, OverviewActivity } from "../blocks/dashboard-overview.types";

export type AppMainProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  metrics: Metric[];
  chart: OverviewChart;
  activity?: OverviewActivity;
  cols?: "1-2" | "1-4";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import BarChart from "../components/bar-chart.vue";
import Panel from "../components/panel.vue";
import StatTile from "../components/stat-tile.vue";
import Timeline from "../components/timeline.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  metrics,
  chart,
  activity,
  cols = "1-2",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<AppMainProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Stack
    :gap="(((density as string) === 'compact') ? '4' : '6')"
    align="stretch"
    class="min-w-0"
    data-slot="app-main"
  >
    <Title :as="2" size="2xl" weight="bold" :id="tpl('{0}-title', id)">
      {{ title }}
    </Title>
    <Grid v-if="((metrics?.length ?? 0) > 0)" :cols="cols" class="gap-4" data-slot="items">
      <Box v-for="m in metrics" :key="m.id" data-slot="item">
        <StatTile :label="m.label" :value="m.value" :icon="m.icon" :hint="m.hint" />
      </Box>
    </Grid>
    <Grid v-if="activity" cols="1-2" class="items-stretch gap-4">
      <Panel
        v-if="((chart.series?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
        :title="chart.title"
        :description="chart.text"
        :id="tpl('{0}-chart', id)"
        class="h-full"
      >
        <BarChart :bars="chart.series" :label="chart.summary" :height="144" />
      </Panel>
      <Panel
        v-if="((activity?.events?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
        :title="activity?.title"
        :description="activity?.text"
        :id="tpl('{0}-feed', id)"
        class="h-full"
      >
        <Timeline :items="activity?.events" />
      </Panel>
    </Grid>
    <Panel
      v-else-if="((chart.series?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
      :title="chart.title"
      :description="chart.text"
      :id="tpl('{0}-chart', id)"
      class="h-full"
    >
      <BarChart :bars="chart.series" :label="chart.summary" :height="144" />
    </Panel>
  </Stack>
</template>
